write: a short incident follow-up write-up for the engineering channel
notes: search was down for 47 minutes on Tuesday, 14:12 to 14:59
cause: a config push set the shard count to 6 for an index built with 8, so the nodes refused to start
the config change was reviewed, but the review tool showed only the changed line, not the index it applied to
alerting fired after 9 minutes because the health check only tested the load balancer, not a query
rolled back the config; no data lost; about 3,100 searches failed
actions: health check now runs a real query (done); config validation compares shard count to the live index (in review); owner for both is the search team
